api-keys.permission-not-mintable: One or more requested permissions are not yours to grant.
api-keys.expiry-too-far: A credential may expire at most one year from now.

email-minted.subject: An API key was created on your account
email-minted.body: An API key named "{{name}}" ({{credential}}) was created on your account. It stops working on {{expires}}.
email-minted.advice: If this was not you, revoke it from your API keys and change your password now.

email-revoked.subject: Your API keys were revoked
email-revoked.body-logout-all: You signed out of every device, so the API keys you created were revoked:
email-revoked.body-password-reset: Your password was reset, so the API keys you created were revoked:
email-revoked.advice: Create new keys once you are sure the account is yours.
